title: Oh, the Places You'll Go!
author: Dr. Seuss
summary: A rhyming picture book that follows a young person setting out into life, with high points, slumps and lonely stretches along the way, all drawn in Seuss's wobbly, colourful style.
readIf: you want a short, encouraging gift for a graduate or anyone starting something new.
skipIf: you want a story with plot and characters rather than a rhyming pep talk.
